description: Implementation of the ContentService interface for managing content entities, including methods for CRUD operations, content file management, and content retrieval in a Spring-based e-commerce system.

classes.name: ContentServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing content entities, including CRUD operations, file management, and specialized content retrieval functions within a Spring context.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content entities filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a given Content entity identified by its ID.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a Content entity by its ID and specific Language.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists ContentDescription objects filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Content entity by its unique code and MerchantStore.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a Content entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new Content or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Adds a content file (image or static resource) for a merchant store.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Adds a logo image for a merchant store.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Adds an option image for a merchant store.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Private method to handle adding an image file to storage.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Private method to handle adding a file (non-image content) to storage.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file associated with a merchant store based on content type and filename.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all content files for a specified merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Retrieves a stored content file by merchant store, file type, and filename.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Gets list of filenames for a specific content type and merchant store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves content description based on store and SEO URL.
